subject.title: Chat context popover: show Anthropic plan usage (5h/weekly/credits) instead of meaningless cost on subscription billing

question: Should maintainers use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/102784 as the canonical fix for the chat popover subscription-usage gap, or require a narrower split first?
rationale: The issue has a protected `maintainer` label and the candidate fix crosses UI, gateway, provider usage, Anthropic plugin behavior, docs, and generated locale output, so automation should not choose the landing shape.

options.title: Review and repair the linked PR
options.body: Treat the linked PR as the canonical fix path, resolve merge state, and review the cross-surface provider usage changes before merge.

options.title: Ask for a narrower split
options.body: Keep the issue open while requesting separate PRs for `claude-cli` usage routing and the richer chat popover presentation.

options.title: Hold for UI direction
options.body: Pause the fix if maintainers want a different cost-control model before exposing plan windows in the composer popover.

recommendation.title: Review and repair the linked PR
recommendation.body: Treat the linked PR as the canonical fix path, resolve merge state, and review the cross-surface provider usage changes before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: This account has the strongest recent provider-usage history and opened the linked candidate PR.
